s: Ubo saip echad: en lebarek shum beraka keshecholetz tepillin, apillu choletzan ereb shabbat ben hashshemashot, sheaz chayyab hu lecholtzan, sheshshabbat veyom-tob lav zeman tepillin hu, ukeshemmenichan alayv leshem mitzva ober al "bal tosip" — mikkol maqom, kevan sheim menichan alayv belo kavvana leshem mitzva en bazeh issur min hattora, ella middibre soperim, mishshum gezera shemma yetze bahen lirshut harabbim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman la, lepikak lo shayyak beraka al zeh, kevan shebbachalitzat hattepillin mitztzad atzmah en bah mitzva, veen choletzan ella mishshum gezera. Veen tzarik lomar keshecholetzan bechol samuk lishqiat hachamma sheen lo lebarek al zeh, shehare layla zeman tepillin hu, veen tzarik lecholtzan, ella sheen morim ken, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman l:
